item.title: Boox Palma 2 Pro hands-on review: Colorful 5G e-reader with Android
item.description: The Palma 2 Pro is a color Android e-reader with 5G connectivity. A camera, speakers, and stylus make it a versatile device for reading and studying while listening to podcasts.

item.title: Review of the Plaud Note Pro AI recorder
item.description: We tested the Plaud Note Pro AI recorder in everyday use: as an AI assistant for recording conversations, processing conversations, and summarizing an English discussion in German. We also look at how it differs from the Plaud Note and how it stacks up against its competitor, the Comulytic Note Pro. Its credit card-style design makes it portable, and the magnetic case allows it to be attached to a smartphone or iPhone. Plugged there, it can also be used to record phone calls.

item.title: Ugreen iDX6011 Pro review: NAS power with desktop hardware and AI features
item.description: We tested the Ugreen iDX6011 Pro, a network-attached storage (NAS) system with a powerful Intel processor and a wide range of features. Storage performance is strong, and the AI features add value, although there is still clear room for improvement. If desired, they can also run entirely locally.

item.title: Dwarf Mini: The compact, smart telescope for great astrophotography
item.description: When a device is called the Dwarf Mini, the name says it all. The Dwarf Mini may look unassuming, but it packs a punch.

item.title: Lenovo Tab K11 Gen 2 Review: A 5G metal unibody price hit business tablet that you may be overlooking
item.description: Notebookcheck reviews the Lenovo Tab K11 Gen 2, a mid-range Android tablet that is almost exactly the same as the Lenovo Idea Tab. However, the Tab K11 Gen 2 does have a few discernable differences of its own.

item.title: Dell XPS 16 review: Two steps forward, one step back
item.description: The 2026 XPS 16 makes massive gains in terms of efficiency and design. Nonetheless, some key sacrifices were made that buyers should be aware of.

item.title: Orbital Pathfinder mouse review: Infinite customization, with a great mouse to boot
item.description: A hands-on review of the Orbitalworks Pathfinder gaming mouse. Where performance meets ergonomics.

item.title: Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus review: More cores and more power for gamers starting at $199
item.description: In this review, we analyze the performance of the Core Ultra 7 270K Plus and the Core Ultra 5 250K Plus in everyday use as well as their gaming performance in combination with an Nvidia GeForce RTX 4090.

item.title: Better than Dreame, Roborock & Co? Eureka J15 Max Ultra review
item.description: The Eureka J15 Max Ultra impresses in the test with solid cleaning, but clearly falls behind top models from Roborock and Dreame when it comes to obstacle detection and innovation.

item.title: A game to cry over: Death Stranding 2 for PC in review
item.description: We subject Death Stranding 2 to a technical and benchmark check with various laptop and desktop GPUs.
